# Machine Learning Fundamentals

This document covers the foundational concepts of machine learning for practitioners.

## Overview

Machine learning enables systems to learn from data and improve their performance
without being explicitly programmed. Key areas include:

- Supervised learning
- Unsupervised learning
- Reinforcement learning
- Deep learning

## Key Concepts

**Training data** is the foundation of any ML system. The quality and quantity
of training data directly impacts model performance.

**Validation** ensures that your model generalizes well to unseen data, preventing
overfitting to the training set.

## Conclusion

Understanding these fundamentals provides a solid foundation for building
effective machine learning systems in production environments.
